text:
support-jess: Customer reports rerank endpoint returning weird uniformly low scores when they pass precomputed embeddings. No dimension error, request succeeded but rankings are nonsense. Provided sample and req id.

support-jess: customer details pasted below. They ran `POST /v1/rerank` with `embed_model: embed-large-v2` and rerank configured to use `rerank-small-1`. Embeddings they sent are length 1536 but our reranker expects 1024. They expected a 4-5x score spread, got all ~0.0001. Request id: req_0a1b2c3d.

support-jess: repro steps they pasted:
```
1) call /v1/embeddings with model=embed-large-v2 -> outputs vectors dim=1536
2) call /v1/rerank with candidate vectors (sent as "embeddings" field) and query embedding from same model -> rerank model rerank-small-1 (expected dim 1024)
3) response 200, body: { scores: [0.00012, 0.00009, 0.00011, ...] }
```

eng-ml-omar: grabbing the req id and sample now. Can you paste the exact payload blob (trimmed) and the customer org id?

support-jess: pasted payload (trimmed), org=acme-inc, req_0a1b2c3d. Payload snippet:
```json
{"query_embedding": [0.001, -0.02, ... (1536 floats)],
 "candidates": [{"id":"c1","embedding":[-0.004,0.01,...(1536 floats)]}, ...]}
```

eng-ml-omar: repro locally with the same vectors. Quick note: API didn't throw because there is a runtime compatibility layer that tries to coerce vector pairs when dimensions mismatch. Investigating logs.

eng-ml-omar: found stacktrace in local run: `vector_pairing.py:78 align_strategy='truncate'` — our fallback truncated the longer vectors to 1024 and ran cosine. Truncation here destroys signal if vectors were trained with different model heads. That explains near-zero uniform scores.

mark_ops: is truncation an intentional compat behavior? That seems dangerous.

eng-ml-omar: it was added years ago for mixed legacy flows, but we missed validating in rerank API when client provides raw embeddings. Currently only when clients call rerank with `embed_source=provider` we validate. If embeddings are POSTed we allowed coercion.

devex-anya: we should block this — at minimum return a clear 400/422 with message "embedding dimension 1536 incompatible with reranker model requiring 1024" and recommend reembedding with compatible model or use `auto_project=true` flag (if enabled).

support-jess: customer asked for quick workaround. Any short-term mitigation we can tell them?

eng-ml-omar: temporary workarounds: 1) re-run embeddings using our `embed-small-1` (1024d) model; 2) pipeline: run a server-side projection transform (PCA) to 1024 — we can offer as paid support but warn about quality change; 3) set rerank to use a model that accepts 1536 (if available).

eng-ml-omar: I'll prepare a hotfix: (a) API-layer validation to reject mismatched dims with an explicit error; (b) logging to capture mismatched pairs and the chosen align_strategy; (c) a short-term patch to stop auto-truncate behavior.

mark_ops: prioritize the validation patch — that prevents more silent incidents. Add a monitoring alert for requests that hit align_strategy!=exact.

eng-ml-omar: creating PR now. Summary in PR: change default from `truncate` -> `reject` for externally supplied embeddings; add 400 payload: `{ error: "embedding dimension mismatch: got 1536, expected 1024. Recompute embeddings with model embed-small-1 or set auto_project=true" }`

support-jess: passing suggestion to customer: reembed with embed-small-1 or wait for our fix. Customer prefers immediate workaround; asked if we can re-run project for them.

eng-ml-omar: we can offer projection service but need ops approval. Mark, can you approve a one-off PCA projection for acme-inc?

mark_ops: approved for a limited job. Create ticket with SLO and record in billing adjustments.

eng-ml-omar: noted. Also adding a small note to SDKs to surface a preflight check: `validate_embeddings(embedding, target_model)` that raises early. devex-anya, can you add to docs/SDKs?

devex-anya: on it — adding a section to the rerank docs and a check in the Python SDK this afternoon. Will include sample error handling code and suggested repro.

deploy-bot: CI pipeline triggered for PR #4582 (eng-ml/validator).

sre-bot: alert created for any request using `align_strategy!=exact` in the last 24h (rule: VECTOR_ALIGN_WARNING).

deploy-bot: deploy started -> canary:eng-ml-validator v2026.3.1

deploy-bot: deploy successful on canary (2026-03-17T15:10:22Z) :party:

eng-ml-omar: canary looks good; no regression and validation rejects mismatched dims now. Rolling to prod in 30m.

support-jess: told customer we rolled a canary that will reject mixing dims and offered projection service; customer accepted reembed instead to minimize risk. They will re-run embeddings with `embed-small-1` and re-call rerank.

support-jess: closing ticket after customer confirms reembed fixed scores (sent screenshot). :thumbsup:

eng-ml-omar: follow-up action items:
- ensure API error message references request id and recommended model pairings
- add SDK preflight helper
- add docs page on "Embedding + Rerank compatibility" with examples

devex-anya: assigned tasks in docs board.

support-jess: closing thread.
